title: Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year
description:
Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game that combines delicious sweets, cookie-balancing challenges, gravity manipulation, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, moving treadmills, and festive Lunar New Year artwork. Explore a charming world of chocolate, cookies, dragons, and paper lanterns while solving entertaining physics-based puzzles.

Step into a vibrant world where Lunar New Year celebrations, chocolate, and physics come together. Discover colorful holiday decorations, traditional dragon motifs, beautiful paper lanterns, and cheerful Asian-inspired artwork that brings a festive atmosphere to every level. The familiar sweetness of the Chocolate makes you happy series meets the joyful spirit of Lunar New Year in this delightful collection of puzzles.

Your objective is simple but surprisingly challenging: keep the cookies on the chocolate bar for a certain amount of time to complete each level. Carefully observe how objects move, anticipate their interactions, and find the right way to maintain balance. What begins as an easy-to-understand task quickly becomes an engaging physics brain teaser that rewards logical thinking, patience, and precision.

Experiment with reverse gravity, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, and moving treadmills to overcome tricky challenges. Changing gravity influences the movement of objects, jumpers introduce bouncing interactions, teleports provide alternative movement possibilities, and accelerators affect speed. Moving treadmills add complexity to positioning and balance, encouraging you to consider momentum and timing as you solve each puzzle.

Face dangerous traps, fire hazards, explosions, and challenging obstacles that make every decision important. Observe the environment, experiment with different approaches, and discover clever solutions to keep your cookies safely positioned on the chocolate bar. Every successful attempt brings the satisfaction of mastering another sweet physics challenge.

With 50 levels of Lunar New Year-themed physics puzzles, Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year offers an entertaining combination of casual gameplay, gravity-based challenges, obstacle avoidance, and precision-based problem-solving. Explore colorful puzzle environments, experiment with interactive mechanics, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing each level.

Immerse yourself in a festive Lunar New Year atmosphere featuring colorful dragons, decorative paper lanterns, and beautiful Asian-inspired visual details. The minimalist 2D artwork combines playful sweets with cheerful holiday imagery, creating a distinctive seasonal twist on the classic Chocolate makes you happy experience.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, challenging physics puzzles, Lunar New Year games, or minimalist brain teasers, Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Experiment with gravity, master interactive obstacles, and enjoy solving clever puzzles surrounded by vibrant holiday artwork.

With its distinctive colorful 2D graphics, playful chocolate-and-cookie theme, and straightforward objectives, Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year delivers an entertaining puzzle experience where simple rules meet challenging physics. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual gamers, and players who appreciate colorful holiday aesthetics, creative mechanics, and satisfying physics-based gameplay.

Key Features• 50 challenging puzzle levels – Solve colorful Lunar New Year-themed physics puzzles that test your logic, patience, timing, and precision.

• Physics-based puzzle gameplay – Experiment with movement, positioning, gravity, and balance to discover effective solutions.

• Cookie-balancing challenges – Keep cookies on a chocolate bar long enough to successfully complete each level.

• Lunar New Year-themed environments – Enjoy colorful holiday artwork inspired by traditional New Year celebrations.

• Dragon-themed artwork – Discover beautiful dragon motifs that bring festive charm to the puzzle environments.

• Decorative paper lanterns – Immerse yourself in cheerful holiday visuals featuring colorful traditional lanterns.

• Reverse gravity mechanics – Change gravity to influence object movement and overcome physics-based challenges.

• Jumpers and bouncing interactions – Encounter jumpers that introduce additional movement and positioning challenges.

• Teleportation puzzles – Explore levels featuring teleports that create alternative movement possibilities.

• Accelerators and speed challenges – Discover elements that increase movement speed and require careful timing.

• Moving treadmills and conveyor belts – Navigate moving surfaces that influence movement and make balancing cookies more challenging.

• Dangerous traps and fire hazards – Overcome challenging obstacles that require concentration, planning, and precise decisions.

• Explosions and surprises – Encounter explosive elements that add excitement and variety to the gameplay.

• Delicious chocolate theme – Enjoy playful environments inspired by chocolate bars, cookies, and colorful sweets.

• Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your problem-solving skills, concentration, and attention to detail.

• Colorful minimalist art – Enjoy vibrant 2D graphics with a playful abstract visual style.

• Simple but challenging objectives – Easy-to-understand goals combined with creative physics mechanics.

• 100 Steam Achievements – Unlock achievements throughout your festive puzzle-solving journey.

• Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

• Single-player puzzle experience – Experiment with physics, discover solutions, and complete challenges at your own pace.

Balance the cookies. Change gravity. Master the jumpers. Discover festive dragons and paper lanterns. Celebrate Lunar New Year with every sweet physics puzzle in Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year!
description_short: Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game with cookies, chocolate, dragons, and paper lanterns. Balance cookies on a chocolate bar across 50 levels using reverse gravity, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, and treadmills. Avoid traps and explosions!
